denseScale.purpose: 9, 10, 11, 12 and 14 px metadata plus 18, 21, 24 and 28 px icon glyphs in bounded browser chrome; not primary reading copy.

components.name: Primary Key
components.description: A consequential tactile action with local blue light.
components.css: .ds-primary-key{height:52px;padding:0 18px;border:0;border-radius:14px;background:#67a2ff;color:#fff;font:650 15px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35) inset,0 10px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.24),0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.34);transition:transform .16s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),filter .16s}.ds-primary-key:hover{filter:brightness(1.06)}.ds-primary-key:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(103,162,255,.42);outline-offset:3px}.ds-primary-key:active{transform:translateY(2px) scale(.99)}

components.name: Touch Field
components.description: Opaque address or text input with a clear focus state.

components.name: Content Surface
components.description: Opaque work surface under floating navigation.

narrative.overview: Nerva combines the structural calm of iPadOS with the physical confidence of a purpose-built control surface. Content remains sober and legible; light appears only where it communicates a live state, a selected target, or an action ready to happen.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained adaptive palette with local semantic light
Opaque work planes beneath navigation glass
Physical controls with grounded press feedback

rules.name: Local Light
rules.body: Color may illuminate an active control or state region; it must not wash unrelated content or become ambient decoration.

dos: Design complete degraded and error states
donts: Do not place glass behind content lists
Do not use color as decoration
Do not rely on hover or perfect gestures
